verses.en: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.pt: Ó Deus, tu nos rejeitaste, tu nos esmagaste, tu tens estado indignado; oh, restabelece-nos.
verses.en_web: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to Shushan-eduth. Michtam. Of David. For teaching. When he was fighting against Aram-naharaim and Aramzobah, when Joab came back, and put twelve thousand of the Edomites to death, in the Valley of Salt.> God, you have put us away from you, you have sent us in all directions, you have been angry; O be turned to us again.

verses.en: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.pt: Abalaste a terra, e a fendeste; sara as suas fendas, pois ela treme.
verses.en_web: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
verses.en_bbe: By the power of your hand the earth is shaking and broken; make it strong again, for it is moved.

verses.en: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.pt: Ao teu povo fizeste ver duras coisas; fizeste-nos beber o vinho de aturdimento.
verses.en_web: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
verses.en_bbe: You have made the people see hard times; you have given us the wine of shaking for our drink.

verses.en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.pt: Deste um estandarte aos que te temem, para o qual possam fugir de diante do arco.
verses.en_web: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Give a safe place to those who have fear of you, where they may go in flight from before the bow. (Selah.)

verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
verses.pt: Para que os teus amados sejam livres, salva-nos com a tua destra, e responde-nos.
verses.en_web: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
verses.en_bbe: So that your loved ones may be made safe, let your right hand be my salvation, and give me an answer.

verses.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.pt: Deus falou na sua santidade: Eu exultarei; repartirei Siquém e medirei o vale de Sucote.
verses.en_web: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.en_bbe: God has said in his holy place, I will be glad: I will make a division of Shechem, and the valley of Succoth will be measured out.

verses.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.pt: Meu é Gileade, e meu é Manassés; Efraim é o meu capacete; Judá é o meu cetro.
verses.en_web: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
verses.en_bbe: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; and Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;

verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
verses.pt: Moabe é a minha bacia de lavar; sobre Edom lançarei o meu sapato; sobre a Filístia darei o brado de vitória.
verses.en_web: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my shoe on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”
verses.en_bbe: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I put out my shoe; over Philistia will a glad cry be sounded.

verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.pt: Quem me conduzirá à cidade forte? Quem me guiará até Edom?
verses.en_web: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?
verses.en_bbe: Who will take me into the strong town? who will be my guide into Edom?

verses.en: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
verses.pt: Não nos rejeitaste, ó Deus? e tu, ó Deus, não deixaste de sair com os nossos exércitos?
verses.en_web: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
verses.en_bbe: Have not you put us away, O God? and you have not gone out with our armies.

verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.pt: Dá-nos auxílio contra o adversário, pois vão é o socorro da parte do homem.
verses.en_web: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
verses.en_bbe: Give us help in our trouble; for there is no help in man.

verses.en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.pt: Em Deus faremos proezas; porque é ele quem calcará aos pés os nossos inimigos.
verses.en_web: Through God we shall do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
verses.en_bbe: Through God we will do great things, for through him our haters will be crushed under our feet.
